description: This Java class 'DefaultGitRepositoryService' implements the 'GitRepositoryService' interface, providing methods for managing Git repositories such as preparing commits, pushing changes, fetching updates, listing branches and versions, and handling repository initialization and cleanup within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: DefaultGitRepositoryService
classes.description: A service class managing Git repositories for version control, including operations like commit preparation, push, fetch, branch management, and repository initialization within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the repositoriesFolder path after construction.

methods.name: getActiveRepositoryTenants
methods.description: Returns a set of tenant IDs with active repositories.

methods.name: prepareCommit
methods.description: Prepares the repository for a commit by checking out or creating branches and cleaning the working directory.

methods.name: deleteFolderContent
methods.description: Deletes the content of a specified folder in the repository.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a file with JSON data to the repository at a specified relative path.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Commits and pushes changes to the remote repository, returning the result.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations on the repository, such as resetting and deleting local branches.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts the current operation by cleaning up the repository state.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches updates from the remote repository.

methods.name: getFileContentAtCommit
methods.description: Retrieves file content at a specific commit version.

methods.name: getVersionsDiffList
methods.description: Gets the list of differences between two versions.

methods.name: getContentsDiff
methods.description: Returns the diff between two content strings.

methods.name: listBranches
methods.description: Lists all branches in the repository.

methods.name: checkRepository
methods.description: Checks if the repository exists locally; if not, clones or opens it.

methods.name: listVersions
methods.description: Lists commit versions for a branch and path, returning paginated data.

methods.name: listEntitiesAtVersion
methods.description: Lists entity files at a specific version.

methods.name: testRepository
methods.description: Tests the repository connection with given settings.

methods.name: initRepository
methods.description: Initializes or reinitializes a repository for a tenant.

methods.name: getRepositorySettings
methods.description: Retrieves repository settings for a tenant.

methods.name: clearRepository
methods.description: Removes and deletes the repository for a tenant.

methods.name: toVersion
methods.description: Converts a Git commit to an EntityVersion object.

methods.name: getAuthor
methods.description: Constructs author string from commit data.

methods.name: fromRelativePath
methods.description: Parses a file path to extract entity ID.

methods.name: openOrCloneRepository
methods.description: Opens or clones a repository for a tenant based on settings.
